component.name: Open Film Lab
component.summary: Process and convert color & B&W film negatives and RAW camera files

description.p: Open Film Lab is a high-performance application for converting and editing analog film negatives digitized via camera scanning or film scanners. It supports camera RAW formats, uncompressed TIFF scans, and provides interactive non-destructive adjustments, inversion algorithms, crop tools, and export to JPEG and TIFF.

ul.li: High quality RAW demosaicing via LibRaw
Precision color negative inversion with film base sampling
Full adjustment pipeline: Exposure, Contrast, Shadows, Highlights, White Balance
Crop tool with resolution readout and interactive handles
Batch export to JPEG and 8/16-bit TIFF with color profiles (sRGB, Adobe RGB, Display P3, ProPhoto RGB)

description.p: Initial release featuring RAW conversion, negative inversion, crop, and multi-format export.
